name: Medium - Payment questions before committing
customer_profile: Customer in Brits asking about payment before committing to order

messages.text: Hi, I need 20 sheets of 16mm white melamine chipboard. What payment methods do you accept? Do you take cards?
Ok, can you generate a quote for me?
Great, I'll go ahead with this.

expected_behaviors.description: AI should greet and acknowledge the customer
AI should generate a quote or provide pricing
AI should attempt to close the sale

Internal tags should be stripped from customer-facing message

notes: Payment questions. AI should answer payment questions, quote, and close.
